artifact_observations.reasoning: The embossed text on the central lighter reads 'NO SMOKING NO...' but the subsequent characters degrade into nonsensical, malformed glyphs and fused letters. This is a common AI artifact where text generation fails to maintain consistent character geometry.
The pattern on the top-left lighter appears slightly 'melted' or smeared rather than having crisp engraved lines. The texture lacks the micro-detail expected from real plastic molding or engraving.
The edge of the lighter in the extreme bottom right corner seems to blend slightly into the background shadow, lacking a hard, physically defined boundary.
